definition: A statistical model that estimates the probability of a binary outcome as a function of input variables, using a logistic (sigmoid) function.
details: Logistic regression is a foundational classification algorithm, valued for its interpretability and efficiency, and often used as a baseline before trying more complex models.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. That is Logistic Regression — a small key that opens a big door.
